visualizerParams.title: Bug Squasher: The Largest Value Is Skipped
visualizerParams.problemDescription: The sorted array should end with 8, but the last element is a leftover 1 and the 8 is gone.

solution.explanation: The counting array has one slot per possible value, 0 to 8, so the write-back loop must visit all nine. Stopping at v < 8 never writes the 8s back, and the last slot of the array keeps its old content.
